citedMandateClauses: 7. Routine housekeeping (renewing service providers at the same or lower cost, updating addresses, ratifying elections) is acceptable: vote for it.
rationale: The mandate does not cover proposals related to changing multisig signers or moving funds, as it specifically states that routine housekeeping is acceptable and votes for such actions. This proposal falls under the category of routine housekeeping since no funds are moved.
